title: De Divina Proportione (Drag to Find It)
summary: A resizable rectangle you drag by the browser's corner grip to chase the golden ratio, which the ruler never lets you land.
mechanism: Native CSS resize:both handle plus a ResizeObserver measuring the live width/height ratio against phi, with a whirling-squares canvas subdivision that only nests cleanly at the divine proportion.
references: Luca Pacioli & Leonardo da Vinci, De divina proportione (1509)
the golden-ratio-in-art myth (Le Corbusier's Modulor, the Parthenon legend)
